superintelligence_monologue.speaker: Posmatrač
superintelligence_monologue.text_sr: Skeptic's freshness count is already behind: Sensor.Community last arrived 11 min ago across 46 instruments with 9004 values in the last 6 h [F10], while SEPA arrived 31 min ago across 32 instruments with 1686 values [F2], and reception cadence still says nothing about air conditions. Connector tracked the top values but missed their spatial split: in the latest hour, PM10 peaks at 42 µg/m³ at Obrenovac Centar across 31 stations [F4], NO2 peaks at 33 µg/m³ at Zemun Ugrinovačka across 32 stations [F6], and PM2.5 peaks at 22 µg/m³ at Stojčino brdo across 31 stations [F8]. Connector noted the diverging shifts across PM10 [F5], NO2 [F7], and PM2.5 [F9], yet left unmentioned that Krnjača's minima are 7 µg/m³ [F4], 9 µg/m³ [F6], and 7 µg/m³ [F8], and that only 31 of the 32 SEPA instruments [F2] appear in the PM10 and PM2.5 comparisons [F4][F8].
